question: For the year 2012, which top 10 evaluation groups have the largest subplot acres when considering only the condition with the largest subplot acres within each group? Please include the evaluation group, evaluation type, condition status code, evaluation description, state code, macroplot acres, and subplot acres.
sql:
WITH joined AS (
  SELECT 
    c.condition_status_code,
    c.state_code,
    p.evaluation_group,
    p.evaluation_group_description,
    p.evaluation_type,
    p.evaluation_description,
    c.subplot_proportion_unadjusted,
    c.macroplot_proportion_unadjusted,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot,
    p.adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot,
    p.expansion_factor
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.condition` c
  JOIN `bigquery-public-data.usfs_fia.population` p
    ON c.plot_sequence_number = p.plot_sequence_number
    AND c.inventory_year = p.inventory_year
  WHERE c.inventory_year = 2012
  AND MOD(p.evaluation_group, 10000) = 2012
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    condition_status_code,
    state_code,
    SUM(subplot_proportion_unadjusted * expansion_factor * adjustment_factor_for_the_subplot) as total_subplot_acres,
    SUM(macroplot_proportion_unadjusted * expansion_factor * adjustment_factor_for_the_macroplot) as total_macroplot_acres
  FROM joined
  GROUP BY evaluation_group, evaluation_group_description, evaluation_type, condition_status_code, state_code
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    evaluation_group,
    evaluation_group_description,
    evaluation_type,
    condition_status_code,
    state_code,
    total_subplot_acres,
    total_macroplot_acres,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY evaluation_group ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC) as rn
  FROM agg
)
SELECT 
  evaluation_group,
  evaluation_group_description,
  evaluation_type,
  condition_status_code,
  state_code,
  total_macroplot_acres as macroplot_acres,
  total_subplot_acres as subplot_acres
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY total_subplot_acres DESC
LIMIT 10
